summary: Complete, unified Pitch Bible for Josh Banday's three original television concepts (Potluck, Dad's Plus-One, Guest Star). Combines the original show concepts document, character bibles (Eric Roth × Michael Connelly methodology), cold opens / pilot teasers, 30-logline arsenal, and 15-attack-vector adversarial stress test into a single executive-ready package. Designed as the master document Josh takes into every general meeting, fellowship submission, and pitch room.
